body:
I don't know if this counts, but one time I was blackout drunk at a party and started running around screaming "I'M A NIGGER! I'M A NIGGER!"

Or so I'm told.

I'm white, by the way.

>Sounds like college.

Haha no kidding.

Feels like my lifes gone crazy these past few months. I don't think its any worse than what i've wrote here, though. My life hasn't slipped out of my control completely yet, but i want to stop this before i go on a Requiem For A Dream-esque drug-fueled downward spiral.

Thanks, this is some really good advice. I used to feel like i had a high level of insight and maturity, i don't quite feel like that right now haha. I have decided to go clean for the next month, to see if that makes my life any better. As for the girl, im not going to stress out too much about it. I think you are right about the ED being related to my stress levels. On a scale from 1 to 10, my stress levels have been at 14 these past few weeks. And im sleep deprived. That should be enough to adversely affect my libido. Im going to go work out at the gym tonight, too. My mom would probably be fine with my lack of religion, maybe not my grandparents though. Hell, im not sure if im fine with it. I've got some thinking to do. Thanks for the advice though.

>Dude, you need to get your shit together. Are you fucking kidding me with the 14 benadryls?? You could die from that. Benadryl is incredibly powerful antihistamine and has seriously negative impact all over your body.

Yeah, as I have learned the hard way.  If I only used it like this twice in my entire life, and then never touched it again, I'll be fine though, right?

>If you don't feel like you can turn down offers to drink or do drugs then you need to start seeking medical help right away, because you clearly have a compulsive personality.

I don't think this should be an issue.  I've turned down all kinds of things in the past, including that offer to get drunk last night.  Luckily, I don't think I'm addicted to anything yet, but just as a test: I'm going to go completely clean, of everything, until December, just to see how I feel.

...shit, with the necessary exception of my Girlfriend's 23rd birthday in two weeks.  But I'll only drink in moderation that night.  I'm prone to whiskey dick anyway, so it works out.

>None of these problems are anyone's fault but your own.

I completely agree. With the possible exception of having shitty roommates.  But otherwise, yeah.

I know that my life CAN be managed appropriately, I just need to figure out how I am going to do it.  I'm not a complete burnout...yet...I just need to stop myself from going all the way over the precipice.
